# Elyzer Furagganan

> SEO and GEO content writer and strategist based in the Philippines (GMT+8), working remotely and part-time with agencies and B2B service firms. Writes clear, well-sourced articles and web copy structured for Google Search and AI answer engines.

## About

- Role: Content Writer & Strategist at First Page Asia, a digital marketing agency in Singapore (since 2022).
- Author and maintainer of the agency's internal Article Writing Guide, its standard for GEO/AEO article structure.
- Licensed Professional Teacher (Philippines). Former college instructor. Bachelor of Secondary Education, Mathematics, Cagayan State University.
- Co-founder of SparkCubs Online Academy, an online tutoring business.

## Services

- Long-form SEO and GEO articles
- Content refreshes and consolidation (merging outdated posts into one updated article)
- Website copy and service pages
- FAQ research and optimisation using People Also Ask data
- Product pages and buying guides
- Editorial support: press releases, expert LinkedIn profiles, short-form video script reviews, rewriting AI-flagged copy

## Industries and markets

- Industries: health and wellness, accounting and tax, corporate services, company registration, cleaning and pest control, organic health products
- Markets: Singapore, Thailand, Southeast Asia; open to clients in Australia and the United States

## Approach

Each article answers the reader's question early, uses question-led headings, tables for comparisons, FAQs drawn from search data, and named primary sources. No rankings or AI citations are promised.

## Pricing (USD)

- Paid trial article, up to about 1,200 words: $120, credited towards the first package
- Starter, 2 articles a month: $360
- Growth, 4 articles a month: $680
- Agency white-label, 8 articles a month: $1,200
